newsitem.title: USA: Trump Hotels holders okay $480 mln purchase.
newsitem.headline: Trump Hotels holders okay $480 mln purchase.

text.p: Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc shareholders approved the $480 million acquisition of the Trump Castle in Atlantic City, N.J. from Donald Trump at a special meeting here.

Trump, chairman of Trump Hotels, did not vote his approximately 30 percent stake in the public company and said at the shareholders' meeting that 82 percent of the other 21 million shares backed the acquisition.
Shareholders also approved the increase of Trump Hotels common share authorization to 75 million shares from 50 million.
Trump said the deal "makes Trump Hotels one of the largest casino companies in the United States."
The Castle joins the Taj Mahal Casino and the Trump Plaza in Atlantic City, and a river boat casino in Lake Michigan near Gary, Ind.
Trump said he intended to make an major announcement regarding the "re-theming" of the Castle within the next two to three weeks.
He declined to comment on reports that the gaming company would enter talks with Rank Organisation Plc about turning the Castle into a Hard Rock Cafe and Casino.

Under the merger, Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Holdings LP, a subsidiary of Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts, would acquire the 100 percent equity interest in Trump Castle for equity interests in Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts LP exchangeable into 5.84 million shares of Trump Hotels common stock, the company said.
